source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: لما كنت بالمدرسة، كان في معلم اسمه أستاذ سعيد.
sentences.en: When I was in school, there was a teacher named Ustaz Sa'id.
He was different from the other teachers.

sentences.ar: ما كان بس يعلمنا دروس، كان يعلمنا حياة.
sentences.en: He didn't just teach us lessons, he taught us life.

sentences.ar: أنا كنت طالب كسلان، ما بحب أدرس.
sentences.en: I was a lazy student, I didn't like to study.

sentences.ar: مرة، أستاذ سعيد ناداني بعد الدرس.
sentences.en: Once, Ustaz Sa'id called me after class.

sentences.ar: توقعت إنه رح يوبخني، بس هو ابتسم.
sentences.en: I expected him to scold me, but he smiled.

sentences.ar: قال: أنا شايف فيك ذكاء، بس إنت مش شايفه.
sentences.en: He said: I see intelligence in you, but you don't see it.

sentences.ar: حكيه دخل قلبي وغير شي فيي.
sentences.en: His words entered my heart and changed something in me.

sentences.ar: بلشت أدرس، مش عشان الامتحان، عشان حالي.
sentences.en: I started to study, not for the exam, but for myself.
My grades improved, and my confidence in myself grew.

sentences.ar: كل ما كنت أوقع، أستاذ سعيد كان يوقفني.
sentences.en: Every time I would fall, Ustaz Sa'id would pick me up.
After years, I graduated and became an engineer.
I went back to the school to look for him to thank him.

sentences.ar: لقيته كبر بالعمر، بس ابتسامته نفسها.
sentences.en: I found him aged, but his smile was the same.

sentences.ar: قلتله: إنت السبب إني صرت اللي أنا عليه.
sentences.en: I told him: you are the reason I became who I am.

sentences.ar: دمعت عيونه وقال: هاي أحلى هدية لمعلم.
sentences.en: His eyes teared up and he said: this is the nicest gift for a teacher.
